Job Description
 Who are we?
 At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.
 Vertiv Service business is designed to provide full life-cycle service support for our customers and as such is a core part of the Vertiv market offering. On site activity is a crucial element of Vertiv Service organization around the world. Vertiv CEs are doing hundreds of thousands of visits every year to maintain the critical infrastructure devices supporting Vertiv Customer applications.
Technical competence and expertise are distinctive attributes of Vertiv Service and a source of competitive edge being able to optimize a unit, a site, or a whole network. To do that the Services tools and applications used by our customer engineers are crucial to capture data in an efficient way to be analyzed by our experts and provide recommendations to optimize every system or site.
Deep industry knowledge, advanced technology, and system expertise are main reasons for customers to select us over our competitors.
Low code applications are becoming a preferred solution to develop applications for Android and iOS platforms, or PWA implementations to deploy around the globe and changing/adapting them quickly to fulfill customer expectations.
We are now looking for a Flutter Developer to join our team in Cluj-Napoca, Romania !
He/She will be part of an organization reporting to the CTO which includes:
Subject matter experts on Vertiv Technologies 
Data architect 
Reporting programmers
Product owners
 Reporting Relationships
 This position will report directly to the Global Services Reporting Manager, who reports to the Global Services Platform organization.
 Essential Role Functions
Work with architects, subject matter experts and product owner to design & implement appropriate technical solutions based on the FDD (Functional Design Document) and TDD (Technical Design Document)
Design and implement technical solutions using Flutter.
Estimate effort required to develop specific functionalities
Develop the functionality and automatize the test of the user cases if required
Apply design & system architecture skills to ensure continual increase in performance and stability of the core system
Document the solution and support defining tests for each sprint
Support junior developers and testers during the development process 
 Additional Responsibilities
Define and put in place best practices to optimize development and test effort.
 Interactions
R&D from different centers of expertise
Academy organization
IT organization
Services Data analysts
Services SMEs in different technologies 
Product owner for Knowledge and Data acquisition
Travel Required: Minimum
 Minimum Qualifications
 The Senior Low code platform developer should have background in programming Service Tools oriented to capture data during on site interventions in industries like Utilities, Telecom, Bank, Retail or any industry with thousands of sites and multiple technologies to be served. It is crucial to understand Low code platforms concept.
In this kind of application, the human interface is paramount, and the solution needs to be oriented to minimize the effort and increase the efficiency of the on-site activity.
Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Computer Science, or relevant technical studies
At least 5 years development experience and 1-2 years of experience with Flutter
Good knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data models
Knowledge of server-side programming languages. Other front-end technologies are a plus, but not mandatory.
Knowledge of JavaScript is preferred, but not mandatory
Good understanding of the SW development lifecycle, versioning and repository management, Agile methodology and familiar with project management and tracking tools like Rally or Jira
Understanding of service-oriented architectures & distributed computing concepts
Good understanding of object-oriented programming principles
Strong Communication skills and capabilities to establish relationships with internal customer at top level
Fluent English speaker. Other languages as Italian, Spanish, French or German are a plus, but not mandatory. 
 Additional Required Attributes
Must be able to meet project deliverables under aggressive time deadlines
Ability to effectively deal with a wide variety of competing demands 
Interviewing and listening skills- interact with individuals and groups about their needs and ask the right questions to surface essential requirements information. 
Good writing skills to communicate information effectively to stakeholders and technical staff.
Good interpersonal skills to negotiate priorities and to resolve conflicts among project stakeholders.
 OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety, Integrity, Respect, Teamwork, Diversity & Inclusion.
